title: Live end-to-end calendar smoke (status / index / project-match)
summary: First LIVE run of the Phase 07B calendar pipeline against real Microsoft Graph (delegated, read-only) with persistence to the real local store. A scope-consent fix was required first (the calendar token-getter hardcoded the never-consented Calendars.Read scope); it now requests the configured Calendars.ReadWrite.Shared scope while the endpoint guard keeps every request read-only (GET-only; no mutation reaches HTTP).

precondition.auth_login: hb-assistant auth login --json -> status: login_success (silent refresh), account <delegated-user>

code_fix.change: _configured_calendar_scopes(configured) picks the configured Calendars.* scope; used by _calendar_probe and calendar index token-getters instead of a hardcoded ['Calendars.Read'].
code_fix.root_cause: Calendars.Read was never consented; only Calendars.ReadWrite.Shared is. Silent token acquisition for Calendars.Read failed (NoTokenError). Acquiring Calendars.ReadWrite.Shared succeeds; the read-only endpoint guard is unchanged, so behavior stays read-only (deferred-tightening posture, same as Files.ReadWrite.All).

redaction_attestation.attendees_stored_as: attendee_hash + bare attendee_domain (no '@', no raw address)
redaction_attestation.note: Read-only scan over calendar_event_index/_attendees/_project_match_candidates/_crawl_runs found no raw subject, organizer/attendee email, location, body, or join URL. No token/UPN/tenant GUID/cache path is included in this committed artifact (redacted to structural facts).

stop_conditions: none triggered — external Microsoft 365 read-only (GET only, guard-enforced); local writes only via explicit --apply; no mutation attempted; no raw/private value or token in this artifact; no-writeback proof_passed=true and all CHECK columns 0 after the live writes; no 07D readiness claimed.
